needs_review.question_text_raw: Candidate on whether the full class of one-dimensional dyadic orthonormal wavelets is path connected in the L2 norm.
Candidate conjecture on whether orthonormal wavelets sharing a fixed wavelet dimension function form a path-connected subset of L2(R).
Candidate on existence of a Schwartz-class Riesz wavelet in the Hardy space H2(R).
Candidate on whether every one-dimensional dyadic orthonormal wavelet has Fourier support containing a wavelet set.
Candidate on whether Riesz wavelets are dense in L2(R) for the fixed dyadic dilation and integer translation lattice.
Candidate on whether the intersection of all dyadic dilates of the negative-dilate space of a Parseval wavelet is the zero space.
Candidate on whether a Bessel wavelet with bound below one can be extended by another generator so the combined wavelet system is a Parseval frame.
Candidate on determining the parameter values 1/8 < b <= 1/6 for which a specified band-limited function is a frame wavelet.
Candidate on characterizing dilation matrices and full-rank lattices that admit an associated orthonormal wavelet in higher dimensions.
Candidate on characterizing dilation-lattice pairs that admit a wavelet set with simultaneous translation and dilation tiling.
Candidate on whether Calderon’s formula holds for every orthonormal or Parseval wavelet associated with a dilation-lattice pair.
Candidate on characterizing expansive dilation matrices for the standard lattice that admit well-localized wavelets, possibly with multiple generators.
Candidate on whether Schwartz-class wavelets exist for integer expansive dilation matrices and the standard lattice in dimensions not already covered by known results.
Candidate on whether every Schwartz-class orthonormal wavelet must have compactly supported Fourier transform.
